generic.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: used when a notification has nothing more specific to say.

join.app.description: Phone notification title: what happened, then the project it happened in. {{title}} is the rest of the title, already in the language; {{app}} is the project's name. Keep the middle dot unless the language separates them differently.

join.conversation.description: Phone notification title: what happened, then the conversation it happened in. {{title}} is the rest of the title, already in the language; {{conversation}} is the conversation's name. Keep the middle dot unless the language separates them differently.

conversationInvite.title.unnamed.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to a private conversation from somebody whose name is not known.

conversationMessage.title.unnamed.description: Phone notification title: a new message in a private conversation from somebody whose name is not known.

conversationMention.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody named the reader in a private conversation. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

channelMessage.many.title.where_other.description: Phone notification title: A person's messages in a small private group's discussion, several since the notification was first due: {{count}} is how many, always more than one in English, so the singular is rarely seen. {{place}} is the group's name.

channelMessage.many.title_one.description: Phone notification title: A person's messages in a small private group's discussion, several since the notification was first due: {{count}} is how many, always more than one in English, so the singular is rarely seen.

channelMessage.one.title.description: Phone notification title: one message in a small private group's discussion. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

reaction.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's own message that somebody reacted to, in a project's chat. {{message}} is that message, as written.

voteDigest.title_one.description: Phone notification title: a daily reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote. {{count}} is how many.

voteDigest.title_other.text: {{count}} changes are waiting for your approval
voteDigest.title_other.description: Phone notification title: a daily reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote. {{count}} is how many.

voteDigest.title.plain.text: Changes are waiting for your approval
voteDigest.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: a daily reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote, when how many is not known.

voteDigest.body.one.text: Open it to try it and approve it
voteDigest.body.one.description: Phone notification text under the title: a reminder of the one change waiting for the reader's vote.

voteDigest.body.many.text: See them under Needs you in Communities
voteDigest.body.many.description: Phone notification text under the title: a reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote. Needs you is a section of the Communities screen, and both are names on screen.

votedDigest.title_one.text: {{count}} change you voted on was decided
votedDigest.title_one.description: Phone notification title: a weekly count of the changes the reader voted on that went live or were closed in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

votedDigest.title_other.text: {{count}} changes you voted on were decided
votedDigest.title_other.description: Phone notification title: a weekly count of the changes the reader voted on that went live or were closed in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

votedDigest.title.plain.text: Changes you voted on were decided
votedDigest.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: a weekly summary of the changes the reader voted on, when how many is not known.

votedDigest.body.text: See how they ended in Your votes
votedDigest.body.description: Phone notification text under the title of the weekly summary of changes the reader voted on. Your votes is the name of a page on screen.

checkFailed.title.named.description: Phone notification title: automatic testing failed on the reader's change. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

checkFailed.title.plain.text: Testing found a problem with your change
checkFailed.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: automatic testing failed on the reader's change.

checkFailed.body.text: It needs a fix before it can go live
checkFailed.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: automatic testing failed on the reader's change.

stalePr.blocked.title.named.text: "{{title}}" is approved but can't go live
stalePr.blocked.title.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has its votes but cannot be merged. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

stalePr.blocked.title.plain.text: Your approved change can't go live
stalePr.blocked.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has its votes but cannot be merged.

stalePr.blocked.body.text: It needs a fix before it can go live, or it will be set aside
stalePr.blocked.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has its votes but cannot be merged.

stalePr.waiting.title.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has been waiting a while for votes. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

stalePr.waiting.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has been waiting a while for votes.

stalePr.waiting.body.days_one.text: Nobody has weighed in for {{count}} day. Share the preview or ask a friend to try it
stalePr.waiting.body.days_one.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has been waiting for votes. {{count}} is how many days.

stalePr.waiting.body.days_other.text: Nobody has weighed in for {{count}} days. Share the preview or ask a friend to try it
stalePr.waiting.body.days_other.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has been waiting for votes. {{count}} is how many days.

stalePr.waiting.body.plain.text: Share the preview or ask a friend to try it
stalePr.waiting.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has been waiting for votes.

connectorSubmitted.title.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's coding agent, working from outside Homeroom, submitted a change. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

connectorSubmitted.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's coding agent, working from outside Homeroom, submitted a change.

connectorSubmitted.body.shared.text: It is visible in the in-progress area (no vote yet)
connectorSubmitted.body.shared.description: Phone notification text under the title: where the reader's agent put its work: shared in progress, not yet up for a vote.

connectorSubmitted.body.waiting.text: It is waiting for approval, and it is being tested
connectorSubmitted.body.waiting.description: Phone notification text under the title: where the reader's agent put its work: up for a vote, and being tested.

agentAwaiting.title.description: Phone notification title: the reader's Claude agent stopped to ask them a question. Claude is a name. Say that it asked, not that it is waiting: the reader may have answered already.

agentAwaiting.body.minutes_one.text: Asked {{count}} minute ago. It is holding for your answer
agentAwaiting.body.minutes_one.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's Claude agent asked them a question. {{count}} is how many minutes ago.

agentAwaiting.body.minutes_other.text: Asked {{count}} minutes ago. It is holding for your answer
agentAwaiting.body.minutes_other.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's Claude agent asked them a question. {{count}} is how many minutes ago.

agentAwaiting.body.plain.text: It is holding for your answer
agentAwaiting.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's Claude agent asked them a question just now.

appHealth.storageWarn.title.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader runs has used most of its storage.

appHealth.storageWarn.body.app.text: {{app}} has used most of its storage. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.body.app.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs has used most of its storage. {{app}} is a project's name.

appHealth.storageWarn.body.plain.text: Your app has used most of its storage. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs has used most of its storage.

appHealth.storageEarly.title.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader runs has used over half of its storage.

appHealth.storageEarly.body.app.text: {{app}} has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit before it fills
appHealth.storageEarly.body.app.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is over half full. {{app}} is a project's name; {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "1.6 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageEarly.body.plain.text: Your app has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit before it fills
appHealth.storageEarly.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is over half full. {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "1.6 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.app.text: {{app}} has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.app.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is close to its storage limit, with the space used and the limit. {{app}} is a project's name; {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "2.5 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.plain.text: Your app has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is close to its storage limit, with the space used and the limit. {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "2.5 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageFull.title.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader runs has used all its storage.

appHealth.storageFull.body.text: New data cannot be saved until an admin raises the limit or allows time to clean up
appHealth.storageFull.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs has used all its storage.

appHealth.deployFailed.title.description: Phone notification title: the latest version of a project the reader runs could not be put live.

appHealth.deployFailed.body.text: The latest change did not go live. Open the app to see what failed
appHealth.deployFailed.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the latest version of a project the reader runs could not be put live.

appHealth.releaseStalled.title.description: Phone notification title: a change to Homeroom itself was approved and has not reached people yet.

appHealth.releaseStalled.body.text: An approved change is not live yet. Open the board to see where it stopped
appHealth.releaseStalled.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change to Homeroom itself was approved and has not reached people yet. The board is the project's list of work.

appHealth.other.title.description: Phone notification title: something is wrong with a project the reader runs.

appHealth.other.body.text: Open the app to see what needs attention
appHealth.other.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: something is wrong with a project the reader runs.

releaseHold.title.description: Phone notification title, sent to platform administrators: a proposed change is held until one of them approves it.

releaseHold.body.named.text: “{{title}}” is held until an admin votes yes
releaseHold.body.named.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators. {{title}} is the name of the held change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

releaseHold.body.plain.text: It is held until an admin votes yes
releaseHold.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators, when the held change has no name.

releaseHold.notice.title.text: A change was not read in full
releaseHold.notice.title.description: Phone notification title, sent to platform administrators: Homeroom's risk rules could read only part of a proposed change. The change is not held.

releaseHold.notice.body.named.text: “{{title}}” is not held, and you can look at it
releaseHold.notice.body.named.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators. {{title}} is the name of the change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

releaseHold.notice.body.plain.text: It is not held, and you can look at it
releaseHold.notice.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators, when the change has no name.
